selected_work: VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_SET_04:F13 R120 bounded live adoption of the shared disassembly producer map for the eight canonical DispRank put_clip_sprite callsites.
summary: R120 continues live closure of Set04/F13 without widening HUD ownership. The eight DispRank clip callsites at 0xB9F3A, 0xB9F5E, 0xB9F81, 0xB9FD0, 0xB9FFC, 0xBA01E, 0xBA035 and 0xBA052 are now exact-RVA template instantiations. Probe-19 handoff, ScopedProducerSemantic and direct SpriteNode pinning derive their RenderScope through GameSemantic::ClassifyCriticalProducer -> DisasmContract::ClassifyCriticalProducer, and each instantiation compile-time requires ScreenHud. The separate DispRank sprani callsite 0xB9DA6 is outside the canonical shared range and remains intentionally unchanged.

risk_review.reason: src/hooks_uiscaling.cpp and render_semantics.hpp are protected runtime-risk paths. R120 does not create new HUD ownership or widen a semantic range; it replaces duplicated ScreenHud literals for eight already-canonical DispRank clip callsites with the shared classifier. The existing R51 runtime evidence also shows producer tagging alone does not prove visual convergence because semantic ownership may arrive after the c64/WVP boundary. Quest3/VDXR runtime validation therefore remains required.
